risks.note: Economic slowdowns, political instability, and currency fluctuations may impact project budgets and procurement cycles, particularly in public-sector engagements; the Company relies on its diverse geographic footprint and multi-sector client base to offset regional exposure.

The industry faces persistent shortages in specialized AI, cloud, and cybersecurity skills, requiring ongoing investment in talent hubs, reskilling initiatives, and leadership development to maintain workforce readiness and competitive delivery capability.
The rapid pace of AI and digital innovation requires constant investment for the Company to remain at the forefront of new developments.
Intense competition from both large technology providers and agile startups requires continuous differentiation through innovation and domain expertise.
Operating across multiple regions necessitates strict adherence to data privacy, AI ethics, and evolving security regulations.

Following growth achieved in the Company's U.S. business in the preceding year, the business moderated during FY2025-2026, and the Company continues to evaluate its go-to-market approach in that region.

The Company witnessed changes in certain senior leadership positions during FY2025-2026, including the Chairman ceasing to hold office effective April 7, 2026, the CEO ceasing to hold office effective November 21, 2025, and multiple Company Secretary changes during the year.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Economic slowdowns, political instability, and currency fluctuations may impact project budgets and procurement cycles, particularly in public-sector engagements; the Company relies on its diverse geographic footprint and multi-sector client base to offset regional exposure.
- The industry faces persistent shortages in specialized AI, cloud, and cybersecurity skills, requiring ongoing investment in talent hubs, reskilling initiatives, and leadership development to maintain workforce readiness and competitive delivery capability.
- The rapid pace of AI and digital innovation requires constant investment for the Company to remain at the forefront of new developments.
- Intense competition from both large technology providers and agile startups requires continuous differentiation through innovation and domain expertise.
- Operating across multiple regions necessitates strict adherence to data privacy, AI ethics, and evolving security regulations.
- Following growth achieved in the Company's U.S. business in the preceding year, the business moderated during FY2025-2026, and the Company continues to evaluate its go-to-market approach in that region.
- The Company witnessed changes in certain senior leadership positions during FY2025-2026, including the Chairman ceasing to hold office effective April 7, 2026, the CEO ceasing to hold office effective November 21, 2025, and multiple Company Secretary changes during the year.
